image_description: A small passerine bird, identified as a Brambling (Fringilla montifringilla), is perched on a thin, bare tree branch against a blurred blue sky background. The bird exhibits the characteristic plumage of a male in transition or non-breeding phase: a greyish-brown head with some darker mottling, a bright orange-rufous breast and flanks, and a white belly. The upperparts are brownish-black with distinct white wing bars and a visible white rump patch. The bill is short, conical, and pale yellow-grey. The legs are pinkish-brown, gripping the branch firmly.
